type.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

date.provenance: Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product, including the PFAS components of intentionally added chemicals and PFAS that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical that also have a functional or technical effect in the product.

who.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

action.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

products.provenance: Menstrual product means a product used to collect menstruation and vaginal discharge, including, but not limited to, tampons, pads, sponges, menstruation underwear, disks, and menstrual cups, whether disposable or reusable.

intentionally_added.provenance: Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product, including the PFAS components of intentionally added chemicals and PFAS that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical that also have a functional or technical effect in the product.
